title: Up-cycling of waste A4 paper into a CaCO3/biochar nanocomposite for wastewater purification: efficiency, mechanism and biotoxicity evaluation
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, 12,2647-2656
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00072F, Paper
Shun Ding, Haoqi Wang, Chunhong Zhou, Yanlan Wang, Xiang Liu
Herein, we report a strategy of treating waste with waste to synthesize a calcium carbonate/biochar nanocomposite, derived from waste paper, as a high-efficiency nanocatalyst in activating PMS for the treatment of antibiotic wastewater.
